service.en: Replacement for a lost birth certificate
service.ur: گم شدہ پیدائش سرٹیفکیٹ کا متبادل

about: Get a replacement copy of a lost birth certificate.
note: Requirements read from the official EHS service page on the checked date. EHS fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Replacement for a lost birth certificate. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: A parent, or someone with a special power of attorney
Or the person concerned, aged 18 or over
documents: Valid Emirates ID of the parents
Notification (QAID) number and birth date entered during the application
timing: Service hours Monday to Thursday 7:30 to 15:30, Friday 7:30 to 12:00
channels: Birth and Death Portal with UAE PASS
